ruleFamilies.name: LOCK_BRACKET
ruleFamilies.property: One lock per run; inside it only the compaction's own HOOK, COMPACT and GATE steps, never a HANDOFF; an orphan lock found on open is discarded, the context restored from the archive and one orphan event recorded. C1's bracket holds one or two COMPACT steps (R2-F1).

ruleFamilies.name: BALANCED_RANGE
ruleFamilies.property: A contiguous range that splits no tool exchange and holds no unsettled DELEGATE; later steps reference the summary forward only and no earlier record changes; every digest the summary names lies inside the range (R2-F2, the COMPACT step's own refusal).

ruleFamilies.name: CHECKPOINT_GATE
ruleFamilies.property: The full range is archived under its digest before anything is dropped; fail closed; the same archive written twice is one record.

ruleFamilies.name: FAILURE_LADDER
ruleFamilies.property: A failed MODEL summary (a gate FAIL included) falls back to a FALLBACK summary that carries artefact digests, step ids and trust labels only; cooldowns rise and persist across a restart (profile defaults 60, 300 and 900 s, Q-CG-4); a typed overflow hands off to CONTEXT-HANDOFF-001, never truncates; a COMPACT counts no iteration but its tokens and time count (Q-CG-3); telemetry is content-free. After a gate FAIL the same bracket appends a FALLBACK COMPACT over the same range, and later steps reference it (R2-F1).

ruleFamilies.name: INSTRUCTION_EPOCHS
ruleFamilies.property: A mid-run instruction change is a recorded delta and raises the epoch; a compaction resets the epoch to 0 and the full set is re-hashed.

ruleFamilies.name: STABLE_PROMPT
ruleFamilies.property: The system prompt's digest is equal on every MODEL step, except on the first MODEL step after a COMPACT step.

ruleFamilies.name: SUMMARY_TRUST
ruleFamilies.property: The summary's trust is computed from the range (UNTRUSTED when a step in it holds or consumed an untrusted tool output) and the summary enters as data, never with instruction authority; a byte-identical summary reused over another range is checked by the COMPACT step against that range (R2-F2).

ruleFamilies.name: ARCHIVE_RETENTION
ruleFamilies.property: The archive's retention is no longer than its trace's; a tenant deletion removes it and leaves a deletion record; a restore from a deleted archive fails typed, never silently.

ruleFamilies.name: GOVERNED_SUMMARY
ruleFamilies.property: A MODEL summary (one a before-model-query hook supplies included, R2-N2) passes both model-query hooks, uses the profile's declared route and passes a deterministic A3 GATE on its bytes before any consumer reads it (R2-N1); a gate FAIL is never overridden and goes to C4; FALLBACK is not a model artefact.

settlements.text: The record sits beside MAS-RA-008's contract, never inside architecture/agent-loop/ (frozen); it is a successor candidate to that contract, which stays unchanged, and the model imports nothing from scripts/agent_loop.py.
The compaction state (archive, lock, ladder) is H10's runtime state; this record fixes its shape only.
The step-kind set gains COMPACT; the 13 hook events, the trust labels and the terminal statuses are unchanged; A3 gains one subject, the summary.
A COMPACT step counts no iteration; its tokens and time count against the budgets.
The profile's cooldown defaults are 60, 300 and 900 s; the vectors test the shape (rising, persisted).

After a gate FAIL the same bracket appends a second COMPACT step, summaryKind FALLBACK, with the same range and checkpointDigest; later steps reference the bracket's last COMPACT step and the MODEL one stays as a failed summary (vector CG-C4-P2 pins the order; CG-C4-N8 refuses another range).

The range checks (summaryTrust equal to the label computed from the range; every digest the summary names inside the range) are the COMPACT step's own refusals, beside C2's and C7's; the A3 GATE stays keyed on the summary bytes alone (vectors CG-C7-N5 and CG-C2-N4).
The gate passes before any A3 consumer reads the summary: a MODEL step, a write tool, a delegation, the delivery and a handoff that carries the summary (vector CG-C9-P2).
A summary a before-model-query hook supplies (SUPPLY_OUTPUT) is still a MODEL summary for C9's gate and C4's ladder (vectors CG-C9-P3 and CG-C9-N4).

outOfScope: The runtime that holds the lock, the archive and the ladder (H10's state); this record fixes shapes and rules only.
The handoff payload itself (CONTEXT-HANDOFF-001); C4 names only the typed overflow that starts it.
Any change to architecture/agent-loop/ or scripts/agent_loop.py: MAS-RA-008's contract is read by digest, unchanged.
Enforcement: the checker checks data only.
